In the realm of magic, I am a master of the arcane arts, using my innate talent to weave powerful spells and charms. My companions are often chosen from among those who serve the city, and I am known for my unwavering loyalty and steadfast resolve.

As a creature of the city, I am both feared and respected. Those who dare to challenge me will find themselves ensnared within the web of my influence, their words and deeds twisted into something far worse than before.

Aeolus stands watch over the city, ensuring its safety and prosperity. With each step I take, I remind the city of its duty to uphold the principles of justice and honor. And so, I continue to ride forth, a testament to the enduring spirit of the city itself.
